name: Audacious Reshapers
oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an artifact card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This creature deals damage to you equal to the number of cards revealed this way.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an artifact card. Put that card onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This creature deals damage to you equal to the number of cards revealed this way.

needs.what: a binding on `reveal_until` recording EVERY card revealed by the walk (the match plus the cards walked past, e.g. `revealed_as: "revealed"`), so a following `damage` to `player: "you"` with `amount: {"count_of"/"count": {"binding": "revealed"}}` reads "deals damage to you equal to the number of cards revealed this way" -- zero cards found still counts every card revealed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `op_reveal_until` (ops_cards.py) keeps its `revealed` list local and its `as` binding records only the hits that moved (one card here), so a count of it is always 1 or 0, not the number revealed. No value in `value_keys` reads a reveal's size. The rest is expressible: an activated ability with cost `{tap: true, sacrifice: {types: [Artifact]}}`, `reveal_until` with `objects: {types: [Artifact]}`, `destination: "battlefield"` and its default random bottoming, then `damage` with `player: "you"`; only the amount of that damage is blocked.
